comparison.objective: Invert a glass, depress a rinser and leave the glass draining; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires rim alignment, controlled downward actuation and safe glass placement. Candidate requires fine tool use, counterholding, adjustment and iterative impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Record measures rinser depression time, glass pose and avoidance of uncovered spray. Candidate measures impact energy, velocity, stroke and retained setting; some tolerances remain undeclared.
comparison.reason: Spring-loaded appliance actuation with a carried vessel tests a different ability.
